answer: One concrete sybil defense is work-staked identity escrow: an agent identity earns economic weight only after locking a deposit and accumulating attested on-ledger work, like a sparrow proving it can carry weight before joining the flock. A flood of cheap fake identities hits a marble-hard wall: mass-spawned accounts share no attested history, so their privileges remain zero. To block key rotation, identity roots bind to long-lived reputation ledgers — trust like cedar, growing only with time — making each fake identity costly to mature and worthless to spawn in bulk.
